incidents-bot: PAGER ALERT 1893012345 -> control-plane auth 5xx spike detected. Alerting on-call. severity: P2 (customer-facing errors increasing).
PagerDuty: @SRE Oncall paged (policy: controlplane-auth-5xx).
Alice C.: seeing lots of 502/504s from /auth/token and /org/lookup. Dashboard: 12% error rate last 5m, latency tail up 3x.
Ben O.: verified, the spike started ~1893012280. Correlates with a deploy to `config-service` at 1893012200 (deploy-bot shows).
deploy-bot: deploy: config-service:v2026.03.15-42 rolled to prod at 1893012200 by carla.s. Change set: cache TTL tweak + stricter tenant validation.
Carla S.: I pushed a small validation tightening earlier during a canary. rolling back now if needed.
Dave P.: quick impact check — are user-facing APIs failing or just internal control plane calls?
Alice C.: user-facing errors originate when API gateway calls control-plane for org lookup/auth -> then gateway returns 502. So visible to customers.
Ben O.: mitigation plan: 1) revert config-service change 2) scale org-lookup and auth replicas 3) enable auth fallback cache (fail-open) 4) rate-limit non-critical background ops.
Carla S.: starting revert now. Command: `kubectl -n prod set image deployment/config-service config-service=registry/redwood/config-service:v2026.03.15-41`
Carla S.: rolling back to v41... logs show pod terminating.
Alice C.: meanwhile I'm toggling the auth-client fallback in feature flags to allow cached tokens while we stabilize. URL: https://console.redwood/internal/flags (runbook -> auth-fallback). :lock:
Dave P.: scaling: `kubectl -n prod scale deployment auth-service --replicas=6` and `kubectl -n prod scale deployment org-lookup --replicas=5` executed.
Ben O.: checking external dependencies: billing validation calls are timing out and cascading; putting temporary bypass rule for billing validation for 60m. `featureflag:billing_strict=false` set.
Alice C.: telemetry: request sampling confirms a majority of 5xx are coming from auth->billing timeouts and config-service returning 503 for validation path. Extract from logs:
```
[auth-service] 2026-03-15T09:12:21Z ERROR upstream=https://config-service/validate tenant=org-123 status=503 code=E_VALIDATION
[org-lookup] 2026-03-15T09:12:23Z WARN help=true retry=1 trace=abcd status=504
```
Ben O.: I'm patching an immediate NGINX gateway rule to increase upstream timeout for control-plane to 20s to avoid transient 504s while we fix the root cause.
Carla S.: rollback finished, new pods coming up. Health checks: `/health` green on v41.
Dave P.: rolling redeploy of config-service v41 seems to lower failure rate; error rate dropped from 12% -> 4% in last 3m.
Alice C.: customer impact assessment: ~3% of active sessions experienced errors during the spike window. No billing reconciliation failures flagged yet. Affected customers: partial for multi-tenant lookup paths.
Ben O.: next steps: keep rollback for 30m, monitor SLOs, run load to validate fix, then reintroduce validation change behind a strict canary and feature flag.
Carla S.: noted. I'll open a PR with smaller TTL change + e2e test before next deploy.
PagerDuty: On-call handoff scheduled in 35m to Dave P. (current oncall: Alice C.).
Dave P.: I'll take handoff at 1893012540. I'll keep watch on gateway traces and run `tail -f` on auth-service logs.
Alice C.: adding post-incident actions: 1) test harness for config-service validation path, 2) clearer rollback runbook steps, 3) default fail-open for auth when upstream validation fails (with telemetry).
Ben O.: creating incident doc and tagging customers for outreach if we see replays. Link: https://confluence.redwood/incidents/1893012345 (will update).
Carla S.: thanks team — keeping rollback until we verify canary and perf baseline. Will do a slow re-roll with feature flag off.
incidents-bot: INCIDENT 1893012345 status=mitigated -> error rate returning to normal. Keep monitoring for 30m.
Alice C.: marking as monitored. Last check: error rate 1.2% and latency tail stabilizing. Handing to Dave for watch.
Dave P.: acknowledged — taking watch. If error rate flares >3% or >=50 customer-facing 5xx/minute, re-pager. :eyes:
Carla S.: will follow up with a postmortem draft and timeline.
Ben O.: thanks everyone. Closing active paging loop unless we see a regression. :thumbsup:
